result:
Confirmado el contrato: `PromptCommand.getPromptForCommand` declara `context: unknown` (types.ts:41), y el mismo defecto ya fue arreglado con el mismo patrón local en `commit-push-pr.ts`. Aplico esa forma a `commit.ts`.

```json
{"file": "src/packages/agent/commands/commit.ts",
 "edits": [
   {"old": "const command = {\n  type: 'prompt',\n  name: 'commit',",
    "new": "type CommandContextWithAppState = {\n  getAppState: () => {\n    toolPermissionContext: { alwaysAllowRules: Record<string, unknown> }\n  }\n}\n\nconst command = {\n  type: 'prompt',\n  name: 'commit',"},
   {"old": "      {\n        ...context,\n        getAppState() {\n          const appState = context.getAppState()",
    "new": "      {\n        ...(context as Record<string, unknown>),\n        getAppState() {\n          const appState = (context as CommandContextWithAppState).getAppState()"}
 ],
 "patterns": [
   {"patron": "prompt-command-context-is-unknown",
    "senal_del_verificador": "TS(2698|18046):.*(context|Spread types may only be created from object types)",
    "fix_generico": "El segundo parámetro de `PromptCommand.getPromptForCommand` está declarado `context: unknown` (command-runtime/src/types.ts). Cualquier uso directo —`...context` o `context.getAppState()`— falla. Se declara un tipo local mínimo con la forma realmente usada (p. ej. `{ getAppState: () => { toolPermissionContext: { alwaysAllowRules: Record<string, unknown> } } }`) y se castea `context as ese tipo` sólo en los puntos de uso; para el spread se castea a `Record<string, unknown>`. Es el mismo patrón ya aplicado en commit-push-pr.ts.",

 ],
```
